description: Found by the fz-go4.27 sweep, INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED by its correctness audit (at 2b431a3dd). Fixture guard_partition_selects_refined_clause (fixtures2, driven by port_type_infer_test.rs): pick({:ok,x}) when positive(x) returns x's refined value; pick({:ok,_}) -> :fallback. Expected main/0 return {int, :fallback}; ACTUAL {int | :fallback, int | :fallback}. Guard-clause dispatch JOINS the union of every guard-selected leaf across the whole function instead of narrowing per-callsite. Contrast direct_calls_specialize_atom_pattern_dispatch_by_input, which correctly narrows plain-pattern dispatch per callsite. So guard-clause dispatch and plain-pattern dispatch DIVERGE in return-type precision — a real behavioral gap, not stale fixture wording (the audit reproduced the exact {int|:fallback, int|:fallback} by mutation). TASK: determine whether guard-clause dispatch SHOULD narrow per-callsite like plain patterns (and fix the type_infer/dispatch path if so), or whether the join is intentionally conservative for guards (document why + fix the fixture TODO's claim). When resolved, fill the port_type_infer_test.rs TODO with the correct assertion.
title: Guard-clause dispatch does not narrow return type per-callsite (unlike plain-pattern dispatch)
